title: 第15章 废弃的洞天福地第16章 崩山拳
content_zh:
第15章废弃的洞天福地。
林浩他们目送这群惶惶如丧家之犬的失败者离开，脸上都不禁露出喜悦的笑容。
在矿洞中的规则是，一个屋子的杂役弟子占领的地方，每月只需接受一次其他屋子的杂役弟子挑战。
打退邹山虎这些人，他们至少一个月不用担心，再有人来抢属于他们的矿区地盘。
“林师弟，你实力很不错啊！
那莫三腾已经加入玄岳宗两年，在杂役弟子中算得上小高手，竟然拿你没办法。”
姜胜目光落在林浩身上，感觉他的表现有些出乎意料，赞叹道。
“林师弟，这一战幸好有你，不然我们恐怕守不住这里。”
另外两名炼气二重的杂役弟子，也对林浩有些刮目相看，脸上浮现出善意的笑容。
“林师兄好强！
有林师兄在，咱们在矿区有好日子过了。”
六名炼气一重的杂役弟子，脸上更是露出崇敬之意，不断拍着马屁。
他们比林浩来玄岳宗时间长，但实力比林浩低，所以直接开口叫林浩师兄。
“几位师兄和师弟说笑了，我刚刚都被那莫三腾打得只能逃跑。”
林浩被周围赞美的话，说得心中有些飘飘然，不过脸上却十分谦逊的道：“还多亏了姜师兄实力强大，及时打败邹山虎，否则我坚持不了多久。”
见他谦逊不居功的样子，姜胜不禁高看了林浩几眼，笑着道：“大家都是一个屋的兄弟，理应相互扶持，争取早日摆脱杂役弟子的身份成为外门弟子。”
“对！
姜师兄说的好。”
其余几人纷纷附和道。
“走，去吃饭吧！”

姜胜很有威望，开口道。
众人肚子早就饿了，皆是连连点头。
来到饭堂，用吃饭凭证换取灵粥，林浩大口大口的吃了起来。
经过这一战，林浩算是彻底融入了这些人中，且拥有着不低的地位。
吃完饭，下午不用干活，他准备回木屋修炼，但姜胜叫住了他，道：“林师弟，你要回去修炼吗？”
“嗯，姜师兄你们不回去吗？”
林浩目光落在同住的其他三名炼气二重杂役弟子身上问道。
“我们有一处灵气浓郁的地方，比在木屋更适合修炼。”
姜胜上前一步左右看了看，见四下无人，才小声的道：“林师弟，你跟我们一起去吧！”
“谢谢姜师兄！”
林浩闻言眼睛一亮，连忙拱手道谢。
“走吧！”
四人一起，沿着一处小道往山下走去，离开当前的矿山，又走了差不多五里地，来到一处陡峭的大山面前。
“林师弟，那适合修炼的地方，就在此山上。”
姜胜开口继续道：“这座山上，有许多野兽，其中对我们威胁最大的是几头狼妖。”
“竟然有妖兽！
姜师兄那几头狼妖是什么境界？”
林浩心中一惊，来到玄岳宗半年，他知道妖兽浑身是宝，炼气境界的妖兽便有妖丹，并且血肉中蕴含不少灵气。
若是能杀死，食用妖兽肉，不仅可提升肉身强度，还可提升修炼速度，那妖丹更是宝贝，可直接服用增加修为。
不过，妖兽肉身比人族强，在前期和人族同境界的修士战斗起来，具备非常大的优势，并不是那么好猎杀，反而妖兽对人族修士来说非常危险。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Abandoned Cave Paradise.
Lin Hao and the others watched the group of panic-stricken losers leave, with joyful smiles on their faces.
The rule in the mine is that the place occupied by the handyman disciples of one house only needs to be challenged by the handyman disciples of other houses once a month.
By fighting off people like Zou Shanhu, they won't have to worry about anyone coming to seize their mining territory for at least a month.
"Junior Brother Lin, you are very powerful!
Then Mo Santang has been a member of the Xuanyue Sect for two years and is considered a little master among the handyman disciples, but he can't do anything to you. "
Jiang Sheng's eyes fell on Lin Hao, feeling that his performance was a bit unexpected, and praised him.
"Junior Brother Lin, it's lucky to have you in this battle, otherwise we might not be able to defend this place."
The other two handyman disciples at the second level of Qi Refining also looked at Lin Hao with admiration, with kind smiles on their faces.
"Senior Brother Lin is so strong!
With Senior Brother Lin here, we have a good life in the mining area. "
The six handyman disciples who were at the first level of Qi Refining showed reverence on their faces and kept flattering him.
They have been in Xuanyue Sect longer than Lin Hao, but their strength is lower than Lin Hao, so they directly call Lin Hao senior brother.
"A few senior brothers were joking with each other. I was beaten by Mo San Teng just now and had no choice but to run away."
Lin Hao felt a little overwhelmed by the praises from those around him, but he said with a very humble face: "Thanks to Senior Brother Jiang for being so powerful and defeating Zou Shanhu in time, otherwise I wouldn't have been able to hold on for long."
Seeing his humility and not taking credit, Jiang Sheng couldn't help but look at Lin Hao and said with a smile: "We are all brothers in the same house. We should support each other and strive to get rid of the status of a handyman disciple and become an outer disciple as soon as possible."
"Yes!
Senior Brother Jiang said it well. "
Several other people agreed.
"Let's go eat!"
Jiang Sheng was very prestigious and said.
Everyone was already hungry, so they all nodded.
When he came to the canteen, he exchanged his meal voucher for the spiritual porridge, and started to eat it with big mouthfuls.
After this battle, Lin Hao has completely integrated into these people and has a high status.
After dinner, he didn't have to work in the afternoon. He was going to go back to the wooden house to practice, but Jiang Sheng stopped him and said, "Junior brother Lin, do you want to go back to practice?"
"Well, Senior Brother Jiang, aren't you going back?"
Lin Hao asked as his eyes fell on the other three second-level Qi Refining handyman disciples living together.
"We have a place with strong spiritual energy, which is more suitable for practicing than a wooden house."
Jiang Sheng took a step forward and looked around. When he saw no one around, he whispered: "Junior brother Lin, come with us!"
"Thank you, Senior Brother Jiang!"
Lin Hao's eyes lit up when he heard this, and he quickly handed over his hands and thanked him.
"Let's go!"
The four of them walked down the mountain along a trail. After leaving the current mine, they walked almost five miles and came to a steep mountain.
"Junior Brother Lin, the place suitable for cultivation is on this mountain."
Jiang Sheng continued: "There are many wild beasts on this mountain, and the ones that pose the greatest threat to us are a few wolf monsters."
"There is a monster!
What state are those wolf demons of Senior Brother Jiang? "
Lin Hao was shocked. After coming to Xuanyue Sect for half a year, he knew that monsters were full of treasures. Monsters in the realm of Qi refining had demon pills, and their flesh and blood contained a lot of spiritual energy.
If you can kill and eat the meat of monster beasts, it will not only increase your physical strength, but also increase your cultivation speed. The monster pill is even more precious and can be taken directly to increase your cultivation.
However, the physical body of monster beasts is stronger than that of humans. In the early stage, they have a great advantage when fighting against monks of the same realm as humans. They are not so easy to hunt. On the contrary, monster beasts are very dangerous to human monks.
